title: Lattice polytopes of large width have real-rooted Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomials
summary: In this note we prove that in fixed dimension the Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomial of a lattice polytope of sufficiently large lattice width is real-rooted. In particular, this implies strict log-concavity and unimodality of the $h^*$-vector and answers a question of Averkov, Hofscheier and the author. For a lattice simplex we prove the analogous statement for its local $h^*$-polynomial, also called box polynomial.
